# What a movie added or deleted tells the connections: Discord, the
# webhook and Plex, created as the long list creates them. A recording of
# its own, so that the long list next door was not recorded again; same
# format, and signalr.json holds what the hub sent after each step.
#
#   GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-notifications/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-notifications make golden-radarr
#
# The original reaches api.radarr.video through scripts/mock-servarr.py, its
# HTTP proxy here, as in golden-library. The connections post to the mock on
# port 18989, which the replay listens on too.
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
config-host-put-allowedhosts-star PUT /api/v3/config/host/1 bodies/config-host-proxy-star.json
config-host-put-proxy PUT /api/v3/config/host/1 bodies/config-host-proxy.json
sleep 8
notification-create-webhook POST /api/v3/notification bodies/notification-create-webhook.json
notification-create-discord POST /api/v3/notification bodies/notification-create-discord.json
notification-create-plex POST /api/v3/notification bodies/notification-create-plex.json
sleep 2
mock - POST /mock/notifications/clear

# A movie added with its options: the webhook names how (`addMethod`).
movie-lookup-route-tmdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/tmdb?tmdbId=438631
movie-add POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add.json
sleep 3
mock added-notifications GET /mock/notifications
mock - POST /mock/notifications/clear

# One added without them, as an API client may: the webhook's payload
# reads the add method off a null and the original records the failure
# (`Unable to send OnMovieAdded notification to: Mock Webhook`); Discord
# is sent all the same. Plex has nothing to do for an addition.
movie-lookup-bare GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/tmdb?tmdbId=335984
movie-add-bare POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-bare.json
sleep 3
mock added-bare-notifications GET /mock/notifications
mock - POST /mock/notifications/clear
notifications-after-bare GET /api/v3/notification

# Deleted with its files: Plex is asked to refresh the movie's folder,
# once the deletion is done. Without them: Plex is not told.
movie-delete DELETE /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}?deleteFiles=true&addImportExclusion=false
sleep 12
mock delete-notifications GET /mock/notifications
mock - POST /mock/notifications/clear
movie-delete-kept DELETE /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add-bare}?deleteFiles=false&addImportExclusion=false
sleep 3
mock delete-kept-notifications GET /mock/notifications
